rules.R-RESOLVED: >=1 link typed resolvedBy whose ref is a live ruling in knowledge/_rulings.json -> resolved. (237-T's R-RESOLVED read how_it_resolves prose for an id; the typed link IS that citation, migrated.)
rules.RULE-K/RULE-D: knowable_how / disposition / ask_when / factory_default are COPIED per open row from 237-T's open-tensions.json, FLOATED — the four ask-whens are Dave's (s238-D3); this file rules nothing. `factory_default` is the GRILL's sense of default (value used because nothing was asked), not s219-D3's shipped option.

links.quote: The law IS a Von Restorff budget with a legal contrast floor attached.

rows.mediating_variable: LAYER: convention governs MECHANISM (where things are, how they behave), distinctiveness governs SIGNAL (which single element carries the moment). Also brand mandate.
rows.factory_default: Converge on mechanism, diverge on signal: standard placement and behaviour, exactly one element carrying the brand moment per view.
rows.ask_when: Q4 names a brand mandate that changes a MECHANISM (placement, control behaviour), not just a signal
rows.knowable_how: GRILL Q4 brand
rows.question_proposed: Your brand asks for a non-standard control here — may we keep standard behaviour and carry the brand in the signal instead?

links.quote: three types with ruled option sets is exactly this trade, made once

rows.mediating_variable: WHO ABSORBS IT: user expertise and task frequency. Also whether the removed complexity is REGULATED (then it cannot be relocated off-screen at all).
rows.factory_default: Nothing is removed without a named destination; progressive disclosure only where Q3 density is comfortable, never where it is compact.
rows.ask_when: never — Q3 already carries it
rows.knowable_how: GRILL Q3 density/width + Q6 fixed/off-limits

rows.mediating_variable: TASK CRITICALITY and whether the user believes work is being done on their behalf. Search and underwriting benefit from visible work; a toggle does not.
rows.factory_default: Acknowledge every action immediately and quietly; show the work only where the system is computing on the user's behalf and the wait is real.
rows.ask_when: never — the component contract says which kind of operation it is
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: object class of the interaction (direct manipulation vs delegated computation) — the same split s116-D1 makes

rows.mediating_variable: WHO IS MEASURING: in evaluation, aesthetics is a confound to control; in shipping, it is a benefit to bank.
rows.factory_default: A beauty pass never stands in for the mechanical rubric; when evaluating, the look is a confound to control, not a score.
rows.ask_when: never — the running skill says which mode this is
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: which skill is running: evaluating (check-against-design-system) or shipping (generate-from-canon)

rows.mediating_variable: LAYER AGAIN: tolerant at the INPUT SURFACE (normalise the phone number), strict at the BOUNDARY (validate before persisting or transmitting).
rows.factory_default: Accept and normalise at the input surface, validate strictly at the boundary, and SHOW the normalisation. Never silently accept ambiguity.
rows.ask_when: never — a behaviour rule, homed at #235's behaviour address
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: pipeline layer: input surface vs persistence boundary

rows.mediating_variable: MEASUREMENT WINDOW: remembered satisfaction (peak-end wins) vs in-task completion and error rate (consistency wins).
rows.factory_default: Polish is allocated to the last pass, never the first; a delightful ending on an unfinished journey is refused.
rows.ask_when: never — build sequencing
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: build sequencing — polish is the last pass by construction

rows.mediating_variable: DEVICE and POINTER TYPE, plus whether the target is a CONTROL (44/48) or a DATA MARK (24).

links.quote: the shell exists; the ROUTING RULE does not

rows.mediating_variable: INTERRUPTION COST vs INFORMATION VALUE: how reversible is the thing the user is doing, and how time-critical is the news.
rows.factory_default: Nothing blocks. Status accretes in a place the user chooses to look; only an irreversible or time-critical event may interrupt.
rows.ask_when: the brief or the data names an irreversible or time-critical event AND the screen carries a notification surface
rows.knowable_how: no slot in the six reaches it
rows.question_proposed: Which of these events must stop someone mid-task — and which can wait until they look?

rows.mediating_variable: WHOSE INTEREST: goal-gradient helps a user finish a task they chose; the artificial-progress variant serves the business.
rows.factory_default: Progress shows real progress toward the user's own goal. A minted or endowed head start is refused, not offered as an option.
rows.ask_when: never — a refusal default; the artefact either measures progress or fabricates it
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: whether the progress value is a real measurement or a minted one

rows.mediating_variable: TIMING: guidance attached to the moment of need beats guidance attached to first launch. Also frequency of use.
rows.factory_default: No first-run tour. Guidance sits in place, at the moment of need, and exploration is recoverable.
rows.ask_when: never — a pattern default
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: pattern choice: in-place signifier vs first-run tour

rows.mediating_variable: REGULATORY CONTEXT and consequence asymmetry. In a bank, a rare case can be the expensive one.
rows.factory_default: Rank by expected cost, not frequency: a rare case with an expensive consequence outranks a common one.
rows.ask_when: Q6 was SKIPPED and the surface handles money, eligibility, health or identity
rows.knowable_how: GRILL Q6 fixed/off-limits
rows.question_proposed: You skipped the fixed/off-limits question and this screen handles money — is there a regulatory requirement it has to meet?

rows.mediating_variable: WHETHER THE REMOVED THING WAS REAL: was an option deleted, or moved out of sight?
rows.factory_default: Every removed element carries a named destination in the used/missing note. 'Simplified' with no destination is a defect.
rows.ask_when: never — checkable on the artefact
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: whether a removed element has a named destination in the used/missing note

rows.mediating_variable: PREFERENCE CLARITY and EXPERTISE — the moderators Scheibehenne et al. identified. Novices with unclear preferences benefit from curation; experts do not.
rows.factory_default: A curated set with the full set one action away; the curation is never described as settled science.
rows.ask_when: never — Q3 density proxies the expertise moderator
rows.knowable_how: GRILL Q3 density/width

links.quote: Bento module counts (s217-D2/D5) should be justified by grouping and scanning, NOT by 7±2.
Bento module counts (s217-D2/D5) should be justified by grouping and scanning, NOT by 7±2.

rows.mediating_variable: NEITHER APPLIES: both are recall-capacity claims and a visible menu is a recognition task.
rows.factory_default: Group by chunking and justify counts by scanning cost. Neither 7±2 nor 4 is quoted as a limit.
rows.ask_when: never — a citation rule about what the brain may say
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: citation hygiene — which number the brain is allowed to quote

rows.mediating_variable: SCOPE OF THE CONSTANT: grammar constant, values variable. Consistency applies to the RULE, not the hex.
FREQUENCY OF USE per element, and whether recall would be from the same screen or from elsewhere.
rows.factory_default: Show what the current step needs; everything else stays reachable without recall. The residual is a flagged observation, never a score.

rows.mediating_variable: TRUTH and REVERSIBILITY: a real count shown honestly is persuasion; a fabricated or non-reversible one is prohibited design.
REGULATORY CONTEXT plus DECISION MOMENT. Disclosure must be present AT the decision, not one click away in a PDF.
AUDIENCE PURPOSE: decision-support (accuracy wins) vs communication to a general audience (engagement can win, with the accuracy loss declared).
rows.factory_default: Rank encodings by accuracy first. If a brand rule overrides the ranking, the accuracy cost is recorded as a decision.
rows.ask_when: Q4 names a chart style that lowers the encoding rank (donut, 3-D, area for comparison)
rows.knowable_how: no slot in the six reaches it
rows.question_proposed: Your brand chart style reads less accurately than the plain one — is this for deciding, or for communicating?

rows.mediating_variable: STRENGTH ORDER: common region beats proximity when they conflict. So a keyline in the wrong place silently redefines the group.
ACTION CONSEQUENCE: acknowledgement is always immediate; CELEBRATION is proportional.
rows.factory_default: Acknowledgement is instant, quiet and always. Celebration is proportional and rare. The two are never conflated.
rows.ask_when: never — a property of the event
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: acknowledgement vs celebration: a property of the event, not of the client

rows.mediating_variable: COST OF THE SECOND ROUTE: does it change the mental model, or just the entry point?
rows.factory_default: Multiple entries, one model. A second route that behaves differently is refused rather than shipped.
rows.ask_when: never — checkable on the artefact
rows.knowable_how: STANDING-RULE: route count on the generated screen

rows.mediating_variable: CONSENT vs CONVENIENCE and REVERSIBILITY. A default on a data-protection choice is unlawful; a default on units or theme is a kindness.
LOAD TYPE: extraneous load (remove freely) vs germane/intrinsic state the task needs held (must stay visible).
rows.factory_default: Before anything is removed, the build records what the user must now hold in their head; task state stays visible.
rows.ask_when: never — a build-time check on the removal
rows.knowable_how: no slot in the six reaches it
